notes: Drona Parva, fifteenth day. No gore: elephant as gold dust; Drona stilled in yoga as gold light. Ashwatthama the son is OFF-FIELD (never a child, never shown). The named elephant is a war-elephant prop. Krishna is the Ep 09 look lock. Yudhishthira is the dharma-king, not Arjuna.

drona.face: Aged acharya-warrior, noble lined face, long white beard and mustache (guru on the field, not a garden sage)
drona.hair: White hair in a saffron-bound topknot, rudraksha — no Kuru silver diadem of Bhishma
drona.costume: Saffron angavastram over pale gold-white armor, bow of the guru, cream dhoti

krishna.face: Youthful divine smile, dusty-blue skin, dark eyes, serene, U-tilak — same face as Ep 09 lock
krishna.hair: Dark curly hair, gold crown with one peacock feather
krishna.costume: Yellow pitambar, flower garlands, gold jewelry, charioteer reins — never a flute, never a bow

yudhishthira.face: Eldest Pandava king, calm noble face, modest mustache, dharma in the eyes — distinct from Arjuna, never a second Arjuna
yudhishthira.hair: Dark hair, simple gold diadem (lighter than Arjuna’s heavy crown), no peacock feather
yudhishthira.costume: Cream-white royal dhoti, gold sash, no Gandiva, no flower garland

bhima.face: Adult Pandava, broad noble face, full dark mustache, fierce dark eyes — never a child
bhima.hair: Dark hair, gold warrior circlet (not Arjuna’s crown, not peacock)
bhima.costume: Deep gold and leaf-green engraved armor, great mace — equal human scale, never saffron sage robes

dhrishtadyumna.face: Adult Panchala prince, dark mustache, determined eyes — distinct from Arjuna, never a child
dhrishtadyumna.hair: Dark hair, Panchala diadem (not Arjuna’s heavy crown, not peacock)
dhrishtadyumna.costume: Indigo-gold Panchala armor, sword of light — never flower garland, never saffron sage robes

arjuna.face: Noble warrior prince, dark mustache, same face as Ep 09–13
arjuna.costume: Cream-white dhoti, gold belt, quiver on back, Gandiva — never flower garland

armies.costume: Muted banners, equal human scale, no gore
